# voipms_voicemails (Data Source)

Lists voicemail boxes (`getVoicemails`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_voicemails" "all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`voicemails`).
- `voicemails` (Attributes List) Voicemail boxes on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--voicemails))

<a id="nestedatt--voicemails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `voicemails`

Read-Only:

- `attach_message` (Boolean) Attach recording to email.
- `delete_message` (Boolean) Delete after emailing.
- `email` (String) Notification email.
- `email_attachment_format` (String) Email attachment format.
- `id` (String) Same as `mailbox`.
- `language` (String) Prompt language.
- `mailbox` (String) Mailbox number.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Mailbox PIN.
- `play_instructions` (String) When to play instructions.
- `say_callerid` (Boolean) Announce caller ID.
- `say_time` (Boolean) Announce message time.
- `skip_password` (Boolean) Skip PIN prompt.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone.
- `unavailable_message_recording` (String) Unavailable greeting recording id.
